'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**Two men disguised in [[burqa]]s attack a [[mosque]] in [[Kabul]] while former [[Afghan people|Afghan]] [[Prime Minister of Afghanistan|prime minister]] [[Gulbuddin Hekmatyar]] is inside. The attackers killed a [[civilian]] and injured two others before being shot dead by [[security guard]]s. Hekmatyar was not injured in the attack. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Sheffield gas supply outage]]
**A burst [[water main]] in the [[Stannington, Sheffield|Stannington]] area of [[Sheffield]], [[England]], floods the local natural gas supply network, leaving thousands of properties without a gas supply. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-south-yorkshire-63846429 (BBC News)]

*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] signs a [[decree]] that [[Ban (law)|bans]] [[religious organization]]s with links to [[Russia]] and imposes personal sanctions against their representatives.
